svg.title: Moving the battery changes aircraft balance
svg.desc: Illustrative Tiny Trainer layout, an illustrative 50 millimeter battery move forward shifts CG 11.9 millimeters forward. Total mass is 253 grams.

g.text: Move the battery. See the balance.

svg.aria-label: Conventional Tiny Trainer with one nose propeller. The highlighted battery and gold center of gravity move together.

g.text: Geometry from the aircraft definition · translucent fuselage
60 g battery ÷ 253 g aircraft × 50 mm movement. Total mass is unchanged.
Illustrative installation, not a safe-CG or clearance assessment. Try the interactive version in the RCForge docs.
